title: Circuit Breaker Resilience Architecture
description: A circuit breaker resilience architecture diagram showing the complete state machine with closed, open, and half-open states, failure threshold tracking, recovery timer, and fallback response strategies for protecting services from cascading failures. This template visualizes the circuit breaker pattern in detail, including how the breaker transitions between states based on success and failure counts. Essential for building fault-tolerant microservices that degrade gracefully under load.
